name: smartpricing/queen-mq
description: Queen MQ client library for PHP with optional Laravel integration

suggest.illuminate/queue: Required to use Queen as a Laravel queue connection
suggest.illuminate/support: Required for Laravel service-provider and facade integration
suggest.illuminate/console: Required by the Laravel Artisan commands
suggest.symfony/process: Required by the PHP worker supervisor
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required by both supervisors and the native Composer launcher on Unix
suggest.ext-phar: Required by queen:supervisor-install to inspect the native release archive
suggest.ext-posix: Required by Laravel lease-renewal worker fencing on Unix
